additional_info.subject: Re: ID0459382-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP/R3 170001594] FW Update Issue CRM:03097000139
additional_info.body:
Good morning colleagues,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0459382
. The ticket was opened for issues to update charger
MP/R3 170001594
form v4.0.11 to v5.0.23.
The update was eventually done with R&D support, by manually updating the FW of the charger via SSH.
As we proceeded with the next FW updates, in order to bring the charger to the latest FW version
v8.0.5
, together with R&D we noticed some issues in the charger FW, resulting in the charger being unable to process a FW rollout and a swupdate.
We forced the swupdate to the charger on 18.11.2025, but this resulted most likely in a FW corruption, and the charger is now offline.
Therefore, it is necessary to go onsite and restore the charger.
However, it is not clear if the issue lies in the FW which was installed in the charger, which a CFast card flashing would solve, or most likely the issue lies on the CFast card itself , which might be corrupted, hence a new CFast card could be required.
Please, be also aware that the charger is currently registered on ISP as
Out of warranty
.
Therefore, since the charger is out of warranty and an onsite visit is required to restore the charger, I will forward this ticket
0459382
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-HU  SI E Queue
. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps. Attached to this email you will find the
Config files
of the charger.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-HU SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.

out of warranty
charger. Based on the analysis conducted with R&D, we found that either the FW was corrupted or even the CFast card itself is damaged.
To proceed further and continue supporting you, we will require an order for remote support for out of warranty chargers.
Please let us know if you would like to get an offer for approximately 25 hours to cover existing and upcoming issues with out of warranty chargers in Hungary. Please note that you will only be charged for the actual time spent.
Once we prepare the offer and receive your confirmation of an order, we will assist you with the CFast card flashing process and restore charger MP/R3 170001594.
